summary: The previous model edit improved branch truth and actual-capacity guards: all 28 core fixtures and all 10 unsafe confirmation fixtures pass. The quality gate still fails because SAFE early exits produce false alarms: an out-of-range condition followed unconditionally by continue before the access; the equivalent break-at-capacity form; and the same early continue in a nested lexical compound block containing the access. The boundary suite is 5/6 and the confirmation suite 17/20. Implement dominance-aware early-exit handling now; the previous edit did not implement it. Search the ancestor CompoundStmt chain of this specific access up to this ForStmt, examine preceding sibling IfStmts at each level, and reason about the branch that reaches the access only when its opposite arm unconditionally exits the SAME loop. An exit nested under an unrelated IfStmt does not protect every path; preserve the already-passing unsafe conditional-break/conditional-continue controls. A nested-loop break exits the nested loop, not this loop. Reuse the actual-capacity, branch-truth predicate proof instead of matching source position or any occurrence of break. Also ensure reversed operand normalization updates the classification of which operand is the look-ahead; swapping expressions while retaining the old AccessOnLeft flag misses equivalent guards. No fixture names, original function names, or fixed numeric capacities may enter the checker. Keep the original patch pair discriminating and all previous unsafe controls reporting. This is explicitly post-hoc development feedback, with full code/model lineage retained. Do not read fixture files; implement the general control-flow relation.
